# Chamuka Daybreak

> Brand pack and UI/UX design system for Chamuka Labs, an applied AI lab. Tokens, React components, and logo icons for Next.js + React 19 + Tailwind apps. Audience: business teams. Feel: playful, warm, African-rooted — not toy-like.

Chamuka Labs ships products as lab outputs. DrawIt is the flagship; FormIt is a sub-brand. “From thoughts to form” is DrawIt’s line only — never the lab’s.

The GitHub repository is https://github.com/chamuka-inc/chamuka-design (formerly chamuka-branding). Apache-2.0 code; names and Daybreak marks are trademarks — see TRADEMARKS.md.

## Packages

- `@chamuka/tokens` — DTCG JSON → CSS variables, Tailwind v4 `@theme`, v3 preset
- `@chamuka/ui` — React 19 components (Tailwind look, UI SDK behaviour)
- `@chamuka/icons` — Daybreak mark and lockups

Install from GitHub Packages (`npm.pkg.github.com`), scope `@chamuka`. Copy `.npmrc.example`. Public npm can come later.

## Optional

- Brand masters: `/brand`
- Digital templates: `/templates`
- Storybook: `apps/docs`
